annotations.title: Get an In Depth maamar or concept card

description: One Chassidut In Depth maamar (book + maamar slug, from list_in_depth): its parts, its concept cards, and its Lessons when it has them. With a concept key, that card: what the term means, what it does in this maamar, and the deeper point. With lesson: n, that Lesson (written to be narrated). Each as an excerpt with a link to the page.

concept.description: Optional: a concept key, e.g. tzimtzum.

language.description: he or en (other languages get English). Default en.

lesson.description: Optional: a lesson number from the maamar's list, e.g. 1 (Hebrew).
